svg.title: Mell command center — interface concept
svg.desc: Concept of Mell's main screen. An editorial conversation thread on the left shows a request, the tool receipts for it, a delete blocked by policy, a spoken request to open IntelliJ IDEA and an approval prompt bound to that action. A right column lists memory in context, system state, devices and safeguards. A command bar at the bottom shows the listening state.
svg.text: İndirilenler'deki eski PDF'leri bul ve sil.

g.text: blocked — destructive action in a tainted turn
